title: Matrix 1-Norm
source_docs: DSP System Toolbox/Math Functions/Matrices and Linear Algebra/Matrix Operations/Matrix_1_Norm.md
text: 计算矩阵的 1-范数，输入 1 路、输出 1 路、无直接馈通；按 {Rounding mode} 指定舍入运算的方法；{Saturate on integer overflow} 指定溢出处理方法、{Accumulator} 指定累加器数据类型、{Output} 输出数据类型、{Output Minimum} 指定模块可输出的最小值、{Output Maximum} 指定模块可输出的最大值、{Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools} 防止定点工具覆盖数据类型，按实例取值。

params.name: Rounding mode
params.values: 舍入运算的方法 Floor (default) | Ceiling | Convergent | Nearest | Round | Simplest | Zero

params.name: Saturate on integer overflow
params.values: 溢出处理方法 off (default) | on

params.name: Accumulator
params.values: 累加器数据类型 Inherit: Inherit via internal rule (default) | Inherit: Same as input | fixdt([],16,0)

params.name: Output
params.values: 输出数据类型 Inherit: Same as accumulator (default) | Inherit: Same as input | fixdt([],16,0)

params.name: Output Minimum
params.values: 模块可输出的最小值 [] (default) | scalar

params.name: Output Maximum
params.values: 模块可输出的最大值 [] (default) | scalar

params.name: Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools
params.values: 防止定点工具覆盖数据类型 off (default) | on
